# 12. Release Scope v1 — capability delta для `0.19.0` working tree

**Code anchor:** HEAD `5249e00849c96cb25fd0f13c5017fbf844db5f3d`; evaluated working tree application `0.19.0` (not committed/pushed in this package).

**Decision source:** [Release Decisions v1](11_release_decisions_v1.md), `DP-03`.

**Detailed matrix:** [12_release_scope_matrix_v1.csv](12_release_scope_matrix_v1.csv), generated by [build_release_scope_matrix.py](scripts/build_release_scope_matrix.py).

**Status:** `CAPABILITY DELTA RECALCULATED / PRODUCT AND QUALIFICATION BACKLOG OPEN`.

## 1. Метод и граница статуса

Исторические [coverage](04_coverage_matrix.csv) и [traceability](07_traceability.csv) не изменяются. Новая матрица сохраняет все 557 `req_id` и накладывает только явные строки versioned implementation traceability `CA-01…15`, [cross-increment addendum](implementation/CA-00/traceability_v0_16_3_release_scope.md), [master-data addendum](implementation/CA-00/traceability_v0_17_0_master_data.md), [calendar addendum](implementation/CA-09/traceability_v0_18_0_calendar.md) и [notification addendum](implementation/CA-09/traceability_v0_19_0_notifications.md). Маркер `CURRENT OVERRIDE` заменяет оценку статуса, но сохраняет ссылки на историческое evidence.

Правила fail-closed:

- нет явного текущего evidence — `Absent`;
- row прямо содержит code/evidence delta — `Partial`;
- `Implemented` означает наличие записанного CODE/schema/runtime evidence, но не UAT или production readiness;
- manual/legal/finance/security/performance/restore/deployment gates хранятся отдельно и не превращаются в PASS;
- deferred capability получает negative acceptance, а не скрытое удаление из scope.

## 2. Итог по 557 требованиям

| Release scope | Implementation status | Количество |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Mandatory | Implemented | 280 |
| Mandatory | Partial | 274 |
| Mandatory | Absent | 0 |
| N/A | N/A | 2 |
| Out of Release | Deferred | 1 |
| **Всего** |  | **557** |

Обязательных строк `Absent` больше нет: `TCA-A-14-09/13` получили отдельные первичные источники и immutable calendar calculation evidence в v0.18.0. v0.19.0 добавляет scheduler/delivery evidence, не повышая ещё частичные `TCA-A-14-01` и `TCA-B-33-11` до Implemented. Это не закрывает 274 `Partial` и ручные release gates.

Два `N/A` — старые enum requirements `TCA-A-13-02/04`, superseded утверждённой dual-FSM `OQ-CA-003`. Единственный deferred req-id — `TCA-B-38-04`, будущий ERPNext→1С adapter. Остальные deferred capabilities из `DP-03` не имеют отдельных строк в 557-row TARGET и учитываются в negative-acceptance register ниже.

## 5. Deferred negative-acceptance register

| Deferred capability | Required negative acceptance before RC |
| --- | --- |
| Client portal | no interactive route/Page/API session for Client; direct URL/API denied |
| Contractor cabinet | no interactive contractor route/Page; contractor role cannot enter internal Desk flows |
| Import Batch | no DocType, API command, menu, scheduler job or enabled migration path in `contract_accounting` |
| 1С and banking integrations | no connector, credential, queue job or automatic transport; `TCA-B-38-04` remains Deferred |
| ЭДО, КЭП, XML UPD/SF | no transport/signature/XML claim; first release remains PDF/DOCX only |
| Telegram | no channel hook, token dependency, scheduler delivery or UI promise |
| Offline/GPS/QR/barcodes | no fields/routes/assets that imply supported operation |
| Advanced BI/payroll/ratings | no enabled reports/jobs/roles or acceptance promise |

## 6. Exit criterion for step 4

- 557/557 rows are present and unique.
- Mandatory requirements without owner: `0`.
- Mandatory requirements without automated acceptance: `0`.
- Mandatory requirements without current evidence reference: `0`.
- `Partial`/`Absent` rows have an explicit evidence gap rather than an inferred PASS.
- Engineering order is published in [First-release backlog v1](13_first_release_backlog_v1.md).

Step 4 is complete as a planning/evidence gate. Product implementation, manual qualification and deployment remain open.
